description: Plan, write and schedule Threads posts in your own voice through your Threadify account, with a review of every post before it is scheduled.

interface.longDescription:
Threadify helps creators run their Threads account from ChatGPT or Codex, in their own voice. This version includes nine skills. Schedule posts you have already approved. Re-share your greatest hits. Build new posts from last week's winners. Add a tracked offer to a week of drafts. Keep your Threadify Brain current, and repair it when drafts get your facts or voice wrong. Learn to write for Threads one short lesson at a time. Cross-post a Threads post to X. Turn a daily post into a draft X Article.

Nothing is scheduled until you have seen the exact review: the words, the account, the time and each platform's version. Then you say yes, and Threadify reads back what it scheduled. These skills do not publish immediately. You need a Threadify account, connected through the official sign-in screen. Posting to X also needs an X account connected in Threadify.
